item.title: GTA 6 Has Recaptured the Beautifully Borked Energy of Skyrim
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a towering technological achievement. It is an open-world game made up of criss-crossing emergent systems that make it feel like life is unfolding all around you, whether you’re there to see it or not. It’s not easy to pull off something so complex — and players are learning that in real time. A few days into its lifespan, players are already finding a host of quirks and bugs that are turning the hyperrealistic GTA 6 into a slapstick comedy show.

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday Star Teases Ominous Fate for His Character
item.description: With Avengers: Doomsday a little less than a month away, Marvel shared its third and final trailer for the movie on Monday. The trailer didn't have too many surprises and mostly covered what fans had already seen in previous sneak peeks. As such, longtime Marvel viewers still have plenty of questions about the movie. Top of mind: Who's going to make it out alive?

item.title: 'Blade Runner 2099' Stars Reveal the Secret to Being "More Human than Human"
item.description: Blade Runner left it ambiguous whether Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford) was human or Replicant, while Blade Runner 2049 focused on K (Ryan Gosling), a Replicant hunting his own kind. Blade Runner 2099 puts a new spin on that formula with Cora (Hunter Schafer), a human fugitive pretending to be a Replicant Blade Runner so she can steal evidence from their headquarters.

item.title: Disney’s Unwatchable New Fantasy Movie is a Sloppy Harry Potter-The Incredibles Mash-Up
item.description: Hexed kicks off with a standard exposition dump explaining that Hexe was formed as a sanctuary for persecuted witches and wizards. Their realm is protected by a magical spell meant to be empowered through a ritual that the extra-special “chosen witch” will complete during an upcoming lunar event. Billie Doe (Hailee Steinfeld) opened a portal to Hexe when she was a baby, and her overprotective mom Alice (Rashida Jones) has been suppressing her daughter’s powers ever since. But when Billie accidentally regains her abilities and travels to Hexe, she runs afoul of its villainous ruler Queen Celeste (Jodie Foster).

item.title: This GTA 6 Moment Is A Trolling Master Class From Rockstar
item.description: Have you ever seen those classic Looney Tunes cartoons where the murderous Wile E. Coyote dashes after the infuriating Road Runner? Usually, a high-speed chase ends with an unexpected comic twist , such as a bundle of dynamite exploding at the wrong time . Perhaps the most famous gag from these iconic animated shorts is the one where the plotting Coyote is tricked into running headfirst into a canyon wall painted to look like the entry to a tunnel.

item.title: Bungie Officially Shows Off Marathon’s Most Exciting Update Feature
item.description: Marathon 's big Symbiosis update has been teased for weeks, but now it's almost here. Developer Bungie is set to release the major overhaul of its extraction shooter on Dec. 8, bringing plenty of new features such as dedicated PvE. One of the biggest additions, however, is an entirely new shell (think of these as Marathon 's character classes) called Bishop. Now Bungie has shared our best look at Bishop yet.

item.title: Pokémon Go 'Twilight Wishes' event guide
item.description: Pokémon Go ’s "Twilight Wishes" event is here to wrap up the "Twilight Trails" season. Running from Nov. 24-30 , this event brings back the Pokémon featured in the previous events throughout the season, and marks the return of Espeon and Umbreon in their themed scarfs, as well as Pikachu in their sun and moon crowns.

item.title: New Xbox Was Originally Planned to Ditch Paid Multiplayer
item.description: All signs point to the next generation of console hardware being historically expensive. With rising component costs, the PS5 and Xbox Series are going for hundreds more than they did when they launched in 2020. In that context, it’s frightening to imagine the price of an even more powerful system, with one estimate placing potential manufacturing costs between $1,200 and $1,800 .

item.title: Pokémon’s Hyped Countdown Might Be Leading to a Letdown
item.description: In October and early November, The Pokémon Company started counting down toward the end of the month, as noted by Serebii webmaster Joe Merrick . Using Poké Ball-themed logos created for the franchise's 30th anniversary , Pokémon teased some sort of announcement for Nov. 30 at 14:00 UTC.

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday Officially Skips Awards Screenings to Avoid Spoiler Leaks
item.description: Don't expect to see Avengers: Doomsday show up on the nomination lists at some of Hollywood's biggest awards shows in the coming months. That's because Disney and Marvel are taking extreme precautions to protect the intimate details of their upcoming superhero blockbuster , going so far as to withhold screeners in hopes of avoiding plot leaks. Still, this strategy won't dash all of Doomsday's award hopes.
